messages.subject: Jake Essex – Professional Elvis Tribute Available for Live Music Nights (Kent)
messages.body:
Hi Dymchurch RBL Club,

I’m Natalie, one of Jake Essex’s agents.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist who delivers a high-energy “Elvis and Friends” show. He takes audiences from raw 50s rockabilly through to 70s Vegas, mixed with golden-era hits from Sinatra, Bobby Darin, Dion and Roy Orbison.

He’s reliable, punctual, and excellent with audiences — perfect for club nights and private functions. Jake is based in South Ockendon (Essex) and regularly performs across Kent and the South East.

Key details:
- Strong 2 × 45 min or 3 × 45 min formats
- No deposit required
- Competitive rates + discount for multiple bookings
- Check him out on Instagram/Facebook @itsjakeessex

Jake is looking to add more regular dates in Kent and would love the chance to perform at Dymchurch RBL Club.

Would you be open to a quick chat or availability? Happy to send more details straight away.

Best regards,
Natalie
Agent for Jake Essex
jakeessexenquiries@gmail.com
